purpose: One governed, hash-bound Frontend consumer-contract input for Phase 4 Backend Final Contract Freeze.

shared_semantics.deferred_or_unknown_mutation_behavior: RETURN_TO_STEP, WAIT_FOR_USER, RESUME, and any unknown mutation fail closed.
shared_semantics.unknown_policy: Unknown major schemas, enum values, event types or payloads, and failed identity closure fail closed; retain at most a visibly stale last-valid projection and request authoritative recovery.

contracts.name: GlobalRunCollectionProjection

RunCollectionItem.activity: {eventId:string; type:string; sequence:number; timestamp:string; taskId:string|null; messageCode:string} | null; required; nullable

contracts.enum_mappings: Use shared total RunStatus and RunStage mappings; preserve backendStatus verbatim; progress method is ACTUAL_TASK_MEAN_V1.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Any unknown status, invalid owner, or invalid invariant invalidates the response. A transient failure may retain only a visibly stale last-valid collection.
contracts.availability: resultAvailability is mandatory; activity, lifecycle timestamps, and nextCursor are nullable only as declared.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource decodes and normalizes the private collection DTO; normalized store owns immutable collection state; pages never consume wire DTOs.
contracts.normalization: Order is (updated_at DESC, run_id DESC); cursor is opaque, versioned, and filter-bound; backend supplies non-financial percent.

contracts.name: PreparedResearchDraft
contracts.enum_mappings: status is exactly AWAITING_CONFIRMATION; previewKind is exactly SCHEME_ONLY; Phase 4 mode is exactly FULL.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Incremental mode, mismatched identity/version/hash, and expired or consumed drafts fail explicitly; regenerate creates a new draftId.
contracts.availability: Tasks and graphs are absent, never empty placeholders; confirmedAt is null; goalTemplateId and backend-declared optional model/template fields may be null.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource normalizes the draft; backend owns Goal/Scheme generation, version, expiry, consumption, request hash, and identity; the UI labels it Scheme/Plan Preview.

contracts.name: ConfirmAndStartResult
contracts.enum_mappings: Durable admission maps to PLANNING, never fabricated RESEARCHING; autoStart is true.
contracts.unknown_behavior: An ambiguous network outcome retries the exact body with the same stable Idempotency-Key. The client never generates a replacement key automatically.
contracts.availability: All identity, request-hash, and reference fields are required and non-null.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource may expose confirmAndStartRun; backend atomically freezes the draft, admits exactly one Run/scheduler start, owns durable replay, and returns the authoritative result. No second Start action exists.

contracts.name: RunProjection
contracts.supporting_schema_invariants: Every NormalizedGraph has exact graphId, runId, version, typed task IDs, and typed edges. Planned graph is immutable; actual graph and graphVersion are backend-owned.
contracts.enum_mappings: Use shared total RunStatus/RunStage, PathChangeType, review, proof, and availability mappings; raw backend status remains preserved.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown/gap/out-of-order input pauses mutation and reloads one coherent snapshot. Sparse graph events set projectionRefreshRequired and never fabricate Tasks or edges.
contracts.availability: Review, result, artifacts, proof, and execution are represented by explicit availability-bearing refs; terminal outcome/event may be null only while nonterminal.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource owns initial DTO validation/normalization; runtimeEventReducer is the sole live business-state mutation point; normalized store owns the immutable projection; pages are read-only consumers.

contracts.name: NormalizedRuntimeEventV1

fields.taskId: string | null; required; nullable only for Run-level events
fields.effect: PATCH_PROJECTION | REFRESH_PROJECTION | OBSERVATION_ONLY | TERMINAL; required; non-null

enum_mappings.name_rule: Preserve the canonical raw backend event name; never synthesize a new business event name.
semantic_guards: task.correction_resolved is explicit same-Task correction resolution
review.resolved is Run-level Review completion and not exception resolution

contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown type/payload/schema, identity conflict, gap, out-of-order frame, or conflicting duplicate mutates no state, advances no committed cursor, retains the visibly stale last-valid projection, and triggers authoritative recovery. Exact duplicate eventId/sequence/content is ignored.
contracts.availability: taskId is nullable only for Run-level events; all other envelope fields are required. Heartbeats are SSE comments and never normalized as business events.
contracts.adapter_ownership: RuntimeTransport validates envelope, schema, identity, ordering, and payload; runtimeEventReducer alone applies supported effects; connection state cannot mutate Run truth.

contracts.name: ConnectionState
contracts.unknown_behavior: Invalid or ahead cursor uses the typed ErrorEnvelope and snapshot recovery. Gaps and unknowns enter RECOVERING. Terminal never reconnects indefinitely.
contracts.availability: Only OPEN.lastHeartbeatAt may be null; every variant retains exact runId and lastSequence.
contracts.adapter_ownership: RuntimeTransport and normalized store own transport state. One active fetch-stream subscription exists per exact Run. Connection state never changes canonical Run status.

contracts.name: FinancialReviewProjection

fields.canonicalRecordId: string | null; required; nullable only for explicit live nonreleased review
fields.releasedResultId: string | null; required; nullable only for explicit live nonreleased review
fields.verdict: PASS | PASS_WITH_UNCERTAINTY | REVIEW | BLOCK; required; non-null

contracts.enum_mappings: PASS_WITH_UNCERTAINTY requires explicit backend authority; RESOLVED is exception history and never a verdict; unknown verdicts do not coerce.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown verdict/check schema or broken owner relation withholds the review and requests a compatible projection; the frontend never infers PASS or synthesizes input-process-output steps from logs.
contracts.availability: canonicalRecordId and releasedResultId may be null only for explicit live nonreleased review; a released B view must close to the same Object/Run/canonical record as A and C.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource normalizes the projection; backend authors verdict, checks, refs, exception history, correction relations, and release identity; UI filters are presentation only.

contracts.name: ClaimTraceProjection / TraceBundle

fields.primaryTaskId: string | null; required; nullable unless backend selects one

contracts.enum_mappings: Trace relation kinds and scoped-anchor kinds are closed, versioned backend values; an unknown relation/anchor kind fails closed.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Missing or unknown relations never fall back to title, text, first, latest, symbol, or metric matching. Return exact unavailable state or fail closed.
contracts.availability: Each missing detail or anchor carries explicit availability. primaryTaskId alone may be null; canonicalRecordId and releasedResultId are required for released trace. report.reportId equals releasedResultId in Phase 4 v1.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource maps private TraceBundleV1 DTO to camelCase. Backend owns all relation truth and opaque scope-bound anchors; frontend owns Back/Forward, focus, scroll, highlight, and overlay presentation.
contracts.required_path: Report -> Claim -> Review -> Task -> Calculation -> Evidence -> Execution -> original Report Anchor

contracts.name: ReportArtifactGroup

ReportRepresentation.artifactId: string | null; required; nullable by availability
ReportRepresentation.sha256: string | null; required; nullable by availability
ReportRepresentation.sizeBytes: number | null; required; nullable by availability
ReportRepresentation.renderer: {rendererId:string; rendererVersion:string} | null; required; nullable by availability
ReportRepresentation.generatedAt: string | null; required; nullable by availability
ReportRepresentation.authorizedRef: string | null; required; nullable by availability

contracts.enum_mappings: artifact_type maps only to HTML/text-html or PDF/application-pdf; representation availability uses the six-state Availability contract.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown format, content type, hash/size mismatch, unsafe ref, or owner mismatch is INTEGRITY_FAILURE. Refresh or reauthorize the exact representation; never expose artifact:// or filesystem refs.
contracts.availability: Each representation is independent. AVAILABLE requires artifactId, sha256, sizeBytes, renderer, generatedAt, and authorizedRef. NOT_GENERATED requires artifactId null.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource groups backend-owned immutable representation records without merging identity; backend owns bytes/integrity and same-origin authorized delivery; the retrieval adapter revalidates exact ownership.

contracts.name: ReleasedFinancialMetric

fields.name: string; required; non-null
fields.canonicalUnit: RATIO | PERCENT | CURRENCY | COUNT | SHARES | INDEX | MULTIPLE; required; non-null
fields.periodBasis: FY | QUARTER | TTM | LTM | CURRENT | DAILY; required; non-null
fields.currency: string | null; required; nullable only when explicitly not applicable or unknown

contracts.enum_mappings: No unit, actuality, period, currency, release, or proof inference. Decimal values remain strings. Claims bind exact metricId; Proofs bind exact calculationId.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown unit, actuality, period basis, proof state, or lineage withholds the metric; there is no fallback or frontend recomputation.
contracts.availability: currency alone may be null under explicit backend semantics; arrays remain present even when empty; absence never implies proof or release state.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource performs lossless snake_case-to-camelCase mapping. Backend is sole financial authority; UI only joins/formats backend displayValue and displayUnit.

contracts.name: ReleasedObjectCoreProjection
contracts.enum_mappings: Latest selection considers only valid RELEASED Runs and orders (released_at DESC, run_id DESC); running or failed Runs never supersede the released slice.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Invalid or unknown release closure withholds the slice. Never fall back to latest arbitrary Run or cross-Object data.
contracts.availability: No released Run means all release IDs/time and reportArtifacts are null with NOT_RELEASED. AVAILABLE means release IDs/time are non-null and sourceRunId equals latestReleasedRunId.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource normalizes the exact Object-to-released-Run-to-result/canonical/artifact closure; backend owns valid-release selection; Phase 5 memory/version/comparison/writeback fields are absent.

contracts.name: ErrorEnvelope

ErrorBody.code: NOT_FOUND | FORBIDDEN | UNAVAILABLE | NOT_GENERATED | NOT_RELEASED | CONFLICT | INVALID_CURSOR | CURSOR_AHEAD | SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE | IDENTITY_MISMATCH | INTEGRITY_FAILURE | UNSUPPORTED_EVENT | TERMINAL | TRANSIENT_BACKEND_ERROR; required; non-null
ErrorBody.recovery: NONE | RETRY | SNAPSHOT_RELOAD | REAUTHENTICATE; required; non-null
ErrorBody.requestId: string | null; required; nullable only when safe context is unavailable
ErrorBody.resource: {type:string; id:string} | null; required; nullable only when safe context is unavailable
ErrorBody.details: Readonly<Record<string, SafeJsonValue>>; required; non-null; redacted allowlist only

contracts.enum_mappings: request_id maps to requestId; RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND maps to NOT_FOUND; HTTP and SSE mappings must be total and versioned.
contracts.unknown_behavior: A non-envelope body becomes a local transport failure and the raw body is never exposed. Recovery follows only the typed directive.
contracts.availability: requestId and resource may be null only when backend lacks safe context; details is always present, safe, and redacted.
contracts.adapter_ownership: HttpFrontendDataSource and RuntimeTransport decode/redact the safe envelope, retain the exact requested tuple, and never substitute another entity or reveal a raw response body.

contracts.name: Availability

fields.status: PENDING | AVAILABLE | NOT_GENERATED | NOT_RELEASED | UNAVAILABLE | FAILED; required; non-null
fields.reasonCode: string | null; required; nullable only for AVAILABLE

contracts.enum_mappings: reason_code maps to reasonCode; absence is never synthesized as AVAILABLE; PENDING is valid only for a nonterminal Run.
contracts.unknown_behavior: Unknown status or invalid invariant becomes SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE, withholds the resource, and triggers authoritative snapshot reload.
contracts.availability: AVAILABLE requires reasonCode null. Every non-AVAILABLE state requires a non-empty stable reasonCode. retryable is backend-authored and cannot be inferred from absence.
contracts.adapter_ownership: The relevant data/transport adapter normalizes AvailabilityV1; backend projection owns state for the exact resource and owner tuple; UI renders it without promoting absence to success.

backend_dependencies.required_final_disposition: Approved schema/route; snapshot/replay race oracle; nested same-Run ownership checks.
Approved total event/payload/effect table; real-event reducer fixture; unknown values fail closed.
P4-SSE-001..020 mapped to one frozen fetch-stream wire protocol and ErrorEnvelope.

backend_dependencies.dependency: Frontend-safe artifact group and authorized delivery
backend_dependencies.required_final_disposition: Group DTO and Claim anchors; cross-object rejection; independent HTML/PDF byte hash, size, and type checks.

backend_dependencies.dependency: Exact Claim Trace bundle and anchor manifest

backend_dependencies.required_final_disposition: Freeze Scheme-only preview, immutable draft/version/expiry/hash, Object/Goal ownership, and honest labels with no invented Tasks.
Durable key/request binding and restart replay; exactly one Run, run.created, scheduler admission, and effective run.started.
Global route/projection with stable order, cursor/filter binding, Object summary, and list/detail revision consistency.
Exhaustive map for cancelled, waiting, capability failure, uncertainty, resolved history, and unknown behavior.
Per-Claim/check and exception-history schema with stable exact refs and backend-authoritative decisions.
Complete event payload or mandatory atomic projection refresh; never fabricate labels, dependencies, or Tasks.

interaction_and_e2e_delta.append_only_rule: Existing interaction IDs 001..070 and P4-E2E-001..106 retain identity; 015 remains a non-executable tombstone.

reservations.semantics: Filter only safe normalized Execution C rows for the exact Object/Run/canonical record. Values are ALL, AGENT, LLM, DATA, TOOL, CODE, RUNTIME, REVIEW, PROOF. Named keyboard-operable group; selected state, empty result, focus, route, query, original sequence, cursor reset, and stale-response quarantine are observable. Backend freeze must choose a cursor-bound actor_type query or prove the complete safe collection is loaded; filtering one page locally fails.

Search only a frozen allowlist of safe normalized labels and exact Task/Evidence/Calculation/Proof IDs within the exact Object/Run/canonical record. Never stringify/search arbitrary input, output, meta, prompts, provider bodies, secrets, or hidden reasoning. Query intersects actor filter; change resets cursor and quarantines stale responses; clear retains focus; retry repeats exact read/query; private-field canary yields zero matches.
Select one valid watermarked Demo Scene through a named select; no production store, route, request, or domain mutation.
Reset only isolated Demo presentation state to the deterministic first step; no production request or mutation.
Move exactly one Demo step backward; at first step the named button is disabled and a no-op; no production request or mutation.
Move exactly one Demo step forward; at final step the named button is disabled and a no-op; no production request or mutation.
